runs.q: How many fields are ready to confirm and charge right now?
runs.ans: Right now 9 events in the 2026 season are closed for entries with fields still waiting to be confirmed and charged. The soonest are the two Orange County Classic events, which are separate events and both start on 2 December, and the Costa da Caparica Pro on 7 December. Across the hub, 451 seats need attention. Most are open seats (312), followed by entries still missing insurance (119) and declined cards (17). Confirming a field won't charge entries that are still waiting on insurance.
